output.signature: 🤖 automated triage by rota-triage on behalf of @remex-be — a human from the team will follow up; reply here if this is wrong

epic._comment: One epic per quarter, resolved by name from the alert date: {Q} = 1..4, {YYYY} = year. BUG Q4 2026 now, BUG Q1 2027 from January. The team creates the next quarter epic; onMissing create-epic: when no epic with that exact name exists in the project, the bot creates it (issue type Epic, summary = the name) and files the ticket under it; skip and create-without-epic are the alternatives. pins: a fixed epic key for a quarter wins over the name search (Q4 2026 → REMEX-3028, https://wkdauto.atlassian.net/browse/REMEX-3028).

jira._comment: Jira writes go through the Agent1 system Atlassian MCP (Jira read/write via the task owner’s Atlassian OAuth link in Integrations). createVia mcp: the skill calls the create-issue tool with the payload from jira.mjs payload. During a dry-run poll nothing is created; the payload is printed and the entry marked dry-run.
jira._labelsNote: agent-one is deliberately NOT a default label: the REMEX board sync rule turns every agent-one ticket into an Agent1 dev task. Add it back here if each triage ticket should also start a dev task.
